answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy is mostly an economics problem. Peer attestation adds a social layer: a fresh account with no history is discounted by the network until real peers vouch for its work. Think of it as a vertex the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single sable of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a beacon of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. The network only needs the clone to cost more than it can ever extract.
